title: Procedural Feature Complete
description: Make procedural feature-complete: expose all brep kernel ops as flow nodes, add reparametrize/divide utilities, extend math/list flow modules with seeded random and series.
summary: Exposed 30+ missing brep flow nodes (bezier, bspline, reparametrize, divide curve, cutAll, split, import STEP/STL, etc.). Added kernel utilities divideCurveSync, reparametrizeCurveSync, reparametrizeSurfaceSync with brepjs Result unwrapping fixes for wire/face/filledFace/surfaceFromGrid. Extended math module with seeded random (splitmix64), remap, trig, and full arithmetic. Extended list module with range and reverse.
